firstPlayerRule: The page does not say who starts the first round; beginning with the starting player, turns go clockwise. In each later round, the player to the right of the previous starting player starts.
houseFallback: Use the picker to choose who starts the first round.

sources.title: Ship, Captain, and Crew — How to Play
sources.publisher: Bicycle Cards (The United States Playing Card Company)

internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards Ship, Captain, and Crew page in a browser. "When starting the next game or round, the player to the right (counter-clockwise) of the previous starting player becomes the new starting player." "Beginning with the starting player, each player in clockwise order takes their turn by rolling the dice up to three times".
uncertainty: The first starting player is not specified.
